coverage: unchanged original39 producer commands with individual API step identities
stale output quarantine and exact restoration

dependencyAudit.auxiliaryTreatment: Retained for existing consumers, separately backed up and restored, never qualification payloads.
dependencyAudit.exactPathReads: Every selected path reference in executed code is a producer except the Daytona unit, which reads archive/cleanup only after executing its existing preparation-only default/resume commands. No new native command was added.
dependencyAudit.foundationOrdering: Existing verify chain produces foundation/contracts/providers/billing/design/boundary/delivery reports before consumers.
dependencyAudit.frozenWrappers: Read unchanged archives and unselected L/N historical inputs, not their quarantined frozen-regression output.
dependencyAudit.conclusion: No deterministic dependency on a quarantined report before its producer was identified.

workflow.actualHead: Explicit PR head SHA fallback to github.sha; helper verifies actual Git HEAD before producer execution.
workflow.originalCommands: All38npmcommands plus original engine diagnostic retained in identical order; ten SQL commands split into individually named/id serial steps.

artifactSchema.partialArtifacts: May contain fewer reports; manifest remains pending with explicit missing/invalid/producer status issues.
artifactSchema.snapshots: Exact checked-out source modes/byte digests before tests, after tests, and after guarded restoration; immutable source changes hold all report payload.
artifactSchema.hashes: Manifest commits every copied report and each of the three snapshots.
artifactSchema.status: qualificationStatus always pending; requiresFinalGitHubJobAndStepApi always true; numeric actualExitCode always null inside collector.
artifactSchema.freshness: All48outputs verified absent after preparation, before any original command; quarantine is outside artifact.
artifactSchema.privacy: Only fixed report files and source path/hash snapshots; no environment dump, raw API output, private input, quarantine originals, TLS keys or provider credentials.

reviewNotes: Prepared state updates truncate before replacing JSON bytes, including shorter prepared/failed status.
Quarantine files and directory entries are fsynced before original unlink; source deletion and restoration have directory durability checks.
Late restoration only targets fixed outputs and refuses unsafe/mismatched entries.
Collector does not validate historical embedded provider proof as current; external review must validate domain assertions, current wrapper inputs and cleanup facts.
Controlled CI filesystem only; no hostile concurrent filesystem guarantee.
